unpinned: npm resolves the transitive dependencies at install time; the package ships no shrinkwrap.
limits: Built-in MCP supports stdio and streamable HTTP; legacy SSE remains unsupported. The six required Compose/computer-MCP task cells are unqualified until task transport, tool execution and runtime proof. No permanent exclusion or 135-task coverage claim.
Published 1.3.0 identity checked 2026-10-16. Source/SDK tests are not a live campaign task or complete accounting qualification.

adapter.base: harbor/agents/installed/pi.py at the pinned Harbor commit
adapter.copied_from: 2026-10-08 campaign adapter; all online/offline runtime guards updated in this unlaunched successor

enforcement: Exact requested version before install; Node and installed package version after install and before runtime commands.

builtin_mcp_contract.evidence_status: Official 1.3.0 source boundary reviewed; required task runtime proof remains pending.

config_shape.mcpServers: Object keyed by server name; stdio command/args or streamable HTTP url.
config_shape.exposure: direct exposes required MCP tools to the model; code mode can also call them.

builtin_mcp_contract.activation: Built-in MCP loads by default; --extension builtin:mcp explicitly selects it. Do not load pi-mcp-adapter or pass --no-mcp.
builtin_mcp_contract.preflight: pi mcp list --json connects, lists tools/errors, closes connections and returns nonzero for enabled-server/config failure. It performs no LLM call.
builtin_mcp_contract.tool_filter: --tools read,bash,edit,write,codemode preserves MCP tools unless a filter explicitly includes mcp__ patterns.

evidence_contract.hook: provider_stream_event; event.data is read-only parsed provider data before normalization, not original wire bytes. Outer event.model/provider/api describe the request.
evidence_contract.persisted: Bounded model and numeric usage observations in existing session custom entries; no payload text or headers.
evidence_contract.qualification: Partial capture never asserts complete call accounting. Explicit model mismatch fails research qualification. Requested-only identity and SDK-only aggregate zeros remain unknown.

final_eval_selection.reason: The official tag resolves to the pinned package source. Runtime/feature smokes and verified retention remain required.
final_eval_selection.scope: Operator selection status; source provenance does not establish runtime or campaign qualification.
